title: COVID-19 border and supply measures — Singapore · Malaysia (2020)
description: On 16 March 2020 Malaysia announced a Movement Control Order effective 18 March, restricting movement nationwide and closing its borders to outbound travel. Roughly 300,000 Malaysians commuted daily into Singapore for work, concentrated in healthcare, construction, manufacturing and transport; Singapore also draws a large share of its fresh food and eggs from Malaysia by road. The two governments had days to settle how cross-border work would continue, who would house and pay for workers unable to commute, whether cargo would keep moving, and what health screening would apply. Positions here are reconstructed from the public record and are not official.
source: Malaysia Prime Minister's Office announcement of the Movement Control Order, 16 March 2020; Singapore Ministry of Manpower advisories on Malaysian employees, March 2020; joint statements on continuity of goods flow.
